capabilities: Preview .xmind files from the file explorer on desktop and mobile
Embed interactive Xmind previews in Markdown notes
Switch between sheets within a preview
Zoom, pan, fit and refresh previews via a floating toolbar
Open or share the original file in Xmind on demand
disambiguation: Not a mind-map editor or Xmind importer; it only previews and embeds .xmind files, and editing stays in the Xmind app.
extras: Desktop opening triggers an Obsidian 'Shell Execution / child_process' capability warning, which the README explains in detail; development source is kept in a private repository; donations are voluntary and unlock nothing; users are told to disable other plugins that claim the .xmind extension.
intentEvidence: Selected structure parsing and rendering components are adapted from yuanzhixiang/obsidian-xmind
problem: Obsidian cannot display .xmind files, so users must leave the app or an external viewer to see their mind maps.

relations.evidence: Selected structure parsing and rendering components are adapted from yuanzhixiang/obsidian-xmind

summary: Viewer that previews and embeds local .xmind mind-map files in notes, with sheet switching, zoom and pan controls, and opening originals in Xmind.
